source_scope.workflow_input: seo_case_scope: full (default) or controlled; other values rejected
source_scope.controlled: Existing native runner executes common public-page checks plus controlled T14 before, T02 changed-metadata recapture, and T14 after; the volatile T09 public-detail phase and optional metadata fixture are excluded explicitly in the receipt.
source_scope.full: Existing sequence still runs controlled checks followed by volatile T09 public-detail checks; any refusal propagates.
source_scope.closure_guard: Controlled mode requires passing receipt entries for both T14 social copy states and T02 changed-metadata recapture before the existing post-case build identity recheck.

verification.local: Formatting, JavaScript syntax, and git diff checks only; no local tests, install, build, native browser, or release because system disk is below the 20 GiB floor.
